title: Moth & Gravel / concept capture library

recording.maritime: Direct MediaRecorder capture of the rendered canvas; silent WebM transcoded to H.264 MP4, variable frame timing retained, padded by at most one pixel to even dimensions. No interpolated motion. Browser capture has uneven frame cadence; encoded duration is reported per file. The recorder requests twenty seconds; frames can begin late under load.
recording.coastalWatch: Existing 15 October recording: 634 screenshots encoded with capture intervals at 30 output fps. 10.85 seconds of uncaptured gaps removed with direct cuts; UI clocks may jump. Silent. No fabricated observations.
recording.screenshots: JPEG browser screenshots. Earlier captures were copied without image changes; their incorrect .png suffixes were corrected to .jpg. Current proxy captures include the local recording controls.

boundaries: Maritime study positions are fixed. Weather and sea use nearby FMI observations where available; defaults remain for missing fields. This is not live voyage footage.
Night footage depicts 19:00 UTC while retaining the current morning weather observations. It is a lighting study, not a weather forecast.
Architecture is reference-informed, with simplified facade spacing, roof profiles and illustrative background heights and finishes.
Coastal watch tracks and alerts are synthetic. It does not run the track-fusion pipeline.
Earlier maritime screenshots predate this capture session; their precise commits are not asserted.
attribution: FMI weather observations: CC BY 4.0, https://en.ilmatieteenlaitos.fi/open-data
